description: List the newest SEC 13F-HR filings loaded here, newest filing day first: filer, CIK, report quarter, SEC filing date, when the filing was loaded (UTC), original or amendment, tracked positions and tracked value. Opens with how many filings are loaded per recent filing day and when the newest of them was loaded, so you can tell whether a quarter's filings are in before reading a filer's holdings. Filter by reportDate (a quarter end) or filedSince. A filing appears only after it is filed with the SEC and loaded; a filer absent from the list has no newer 13F on file here.

filedSince.description: Earliest SEC filing date in YYYY-MM-DD format (omit for no lower bound)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of filings to return (default: 20, clamped to 1-500)

offset.description: Number of filings to skip before returning rows (default: 0, clamped to 0-100000). For the next page, add the returned row count to the current offset.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format to list only that quarter's filings (omit for every quarter)

name: GetLatest13FFilings
title: Latest 13F Filings
